hooks.text: 死亡后仍保留本局赚取的现金，可兑换永久强化与新内容，让失败也推动长期成长。
hooks.excerpt: Even after death, you keep your hard-earned money which can be exchanged for persistent improvements and unlockable content, allowing you to progress further while adding depth to the overall gameplay.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 多名能力各异的角色搭配大量武器与技能，可反复试验不同生存构筑。
hooks.excerpt: Bloodshed boasts a diverse roster of playable characters, each with distinct abilities and playstyles, providing a personalized gameplay experience. With a vast selection of weapons and skills at your disposal, you can experiment with various builds to discover the ideal strategy for your survival.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 射击可在自动开火与手动瞄准间切换，自由选择幸存者式割草或传统FPS操控。
hooks.excerpt: Swappable Shooting Modes: Use auto-shooting for a more Survivors-like experience, or “switch to manual” to aim and shoot your way!
